## Episode Thesis

This episode is almost entirely about Swedish politics, with no market or stock discussion. DI editorial writer Tobias Wikström and Katalys head Daniel Suhonen discuss the Centre Party's decision to back Ulf Kristersson as prime minister in a four-party government. Suhonen expects the government to be historically weak and dependent on SD. He also expects a backlash over betrayal on the red-green side and a likely crisis for the Social Democrats, including pressure on Magdalena Andersson to step down. Wikström expects traditional centre-right economic policy, with budget support from SD. The only companies named are podcast sponsors and media outlets, and no investment views are given.
